# Avatar explainer videos

**Script, voice, framing, render, lip-sync QA, captions and labels for talking-avatar explainers made with HeyGen or OmniHuman.**

Makes talking-avatar explainer videos with HeyGen Avatar IV or OmniHuman through the @useclaudia/media avatar kind — when an avatar is the right format, scripts written for a face, voice choice, photo framing, the HeyGen v3 request fields (aspect, motion prompt, captions, expressiveness), a dry run and spend cap, lip-sync and drift QA, captions and cutaways, and AI labels on every platform. Use when someone wants an AI presenter, a talking-head explainer, a product walkthrough with an avatar, a "Claudia explains" video, or a HeyGen video made through code.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 1–2 h per 60–120 s video | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli`, `@useclaudia/social` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Decide if an avatar fits
2. Write the script for a face
3. Pick the route and the voice
4. Frame the image for the output
5. Render with a dry run first
6. QA the lip-sync and the face
7. Add captions and cutaways
8. Label, approve and publish

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/avatar-explainer-videos.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/avatar-explainer-videos.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/avatar-explainer-videos.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/avatar-explainer-videos.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill avatar-explainer-videos`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `avatar-explainer-videos.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).
